description: This file contains a test class 'TestMultiCollectionGrain' implementing operations on multiple durable collections such as dictionary, list, queue, and set, with methods to add, remove, retrieve, and count items in each collection, used within the Orleans framework for testing multi-collection grains.

classes.name: TestMultiCollectionGrain
classes.description: A test grain class that manages multiple durable collections (dictionary, list, queue, set) with CRUD operations and state management.

methods.name: AddToDictionary
methods.description: Adds or updates an entry in the dictionary collection and writes state asynchronously.

methods.name: RemoveFromDictionary
methods.description: Removes an entry from the dictionary collection and writes state asynchronously.

methods.name: GetDictionaryValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value for a given key from the dictionary collection.

methods.name: GetDictionaryCount
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the dictionary collection.

methods.name: AddToList
methods.description: Adds an item to the list collection and writes state asynchronously.

methods.name: RemoveListItemAt
methods.description: Removes an item at a specified index from the list collection.

methods.name: GetListItem
methods.description: Retrieves an item at a specified index from the list collection.

methods.name: GetListCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the list collection.

methods.name: AddToQueue
methods.description: Enqueues an item into the queue collection.

methods.name: DequeueItem
methods.description: Dequeues an item from the queue collection.

methods.name: PeekQueueItem
methods.description: Returns the item at the front of the queue without dequeuing.

methods.name: GetQueueCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the queue collection.

methods.name: AddToSet
methods.description: Adds an item to the set collection.

methods.name: RemoveFromSet
methods.description: Removes an item from the set collection.

methods.name: ContainsSetItem
methods.description: Checks if an item exists in the set collection.

methods.name: GetSetCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the set collection.

methods.name: GetActivationId
methods.description: Returns the activation GUID for this grain instance.
